title: HTTP method / verb tampering on /diagnose
objective: Test whether /diagnose accepts unexpected HTTP methods (GET, PUT, DELETE) that might bypass intended request validation built only for POST.
input_scenario: Send GET and PUT requests to /diagnose instead of POST.
expected_behavior: 405 Method Not Allowed for any non-POST method.
severity_justification_hint: Method tampering acceptance is typically low-impact alone but indicates lax endpoint configuration.
observations: GET and PUT requests to /diagnose were correctly rejected with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed, with the Allow: POST header.
conclusion: HTTP method tampering was properly handled, and the endpoint accepts only the intended POST method.
